title: Add Git metadata write preflight
summary: Autonomous runs can currently implement and validate a slice before discovering that the local environment cannot write .git/index.lock for staging or commits. Add a read-only-safe preflight that detects whether Git metadata is writable and expose it through alpha readiness reporting.
expectedFailureModes: Autonomous runs only discover a read-only Git index after implementation and validation work is complete.
The preflight mutates repository history or leaves files behind in .git.
Alpha readiness hides the Git write-access blocker and implies commits can be made when they cannot.
nextAction: Add a Git metadata write-access validator, wire it into alpha readiness output, document the blocker semantics, and validate the help/readiness paths.
